dimensions.note: The SSH private key is named by ssh_key_ref (vault + key) and resolved at execution through context.vaultService.get (the runtime object shape, driven by a plain-object context in tests); it reaches ssh-agent over stdin and never appears on argv, in logs or in results. Authorized keys travel to the host on stdin. No content-derived hash on any argv or remote script text. README examples use vault references only and never --json (swamp-club lab 3555).
One structured log line per method (host, phase, changed operations, revert token/expiry); no key material, command text or remote output in log fields.

Every plan step is checked: nft -c failure stops before nft -f, a failing table listing aborts arm instead of emptying the snapshot, commit after expiry and stacking while armed are typed refusals (live cells 13, 14). The revoke step is fail-closed: an account lookup that is neither found nor absent, a failing id -nG, or sudo still listed after gpasswd exits non-zero with the marker kept and the account left on pending_revoke. Residual MEDIUM (astra, filed High, downgraded): getent exit 2 also covers an unavailable NSS backend; markers exist only for local /etc/passwd accounts (usermod -aG refuses others), so only a remote-NSS account's keys file can be dropped from pending during an outage. Residual MEDIUM (terra, filed High, downgraded): keys removal precedes sudo removal, so an account that makes its own ~/.ssh unwritable stops the step before gpasswd; the run fails loudly and stays pending. Both are LOGBOOK follow-ups.

Unit, golden-render and shell tests (server_host, nftables, armed_revert incl. a real-sh harness, base_shell with failing gpasswd/id/getent stubs, plans, validate, ssh); fixtures use real nft JSON listing shapes (range collapse, /32, merges). Live end to end on a throwaway VPS: 19/21 on e17a609 plus 12/12 re-run cells on f66c8d0/2aade6d/0cfe601 covering apply_base, admin change and revoke (deferred, completed, symlinked ~/.ssh), every CIDR shape, lockdown, fresh-connection verify, commit and survival, revert firing for firewall and lockdown, refusals, get/sync observations and final cleanup. Untested live: failing gpasswd, id -nG and account lookup on the revoke path (sh stub tests only).

apply_base with identical inputs emits no remote command (live 83 ms); an identical firewall re-apply arms no new timer (live). A host-side systemd timer armed before any change restores the previous managed table (or removes it) and leaves foreign tables intact; only the generation that armed it can disarm it. Residual LOW (terra, filed High, downgraded under the single-orchestrator ruling): an account recreated by another root actor between the lookup and the marker removal keeps sudo with no marker.

nftables JSON read-back is the comparison source (never the render text); merge-aware address sets, table flags and sets; add+delete of the managed table instead of a destroy. Requires a Debian/Ubuntu target with nft, systemd, runuser and the shadow tools.

Remote temp files are created with mktemp beside their destination and renamed or removed; the revert timer and its state directory are removed on commit or after firing (live cell 21/30). Accepted debt: server-host keeps its own vendored transport rather than the canonical ssh-host blob; strict-only host keys.

Manifest: @randybias/server-host, two-sentence description, Apache-2.0, additionalFiles README.md and LICENSE.txt. Mutating methods start DESTRUCTIVE, render/get/sync start READ-ONLY. README examples include the required host_keys and vault references only. Fixtures use RFC 5737 CIDRs and example.com/.test; leak scan, gitleaks and fixture guard pass; live receipts folded into the LOGBOOK with real addresses redacted.

All arguments are strict objects; host, port, user, CIDRs, ports and package names carry grammars and bounds; host_keys required (1-16); host_key_policy accepts only strict (insecure_tofu removed under ruling 4g). 0.0.0.0/0 or equivalent halves are refused without an explicit acknowledgement, and lockdown never allows SSH from anywhere (live 16-18).
host_state and observation: infinite, GC 20/5; revert and firewall_render: 1d, GC 5.

Phase methods apply_base, apply_firewall, lockdown and commit are actions; render_firewall, get and sync are read-only. Changing admin_user revokes the previous account's managed keys and tool-granted sudo, deferring when the run logs in as that account (pending_revoke).
Inputs, CIDR safety and host-key pins are validated before any spawn; nft -c pre-checks every ruleset before it is applied; a revert is armed before any firewall change.
Per-host instances state-, revert-, observation- and render-<host> with unsafe characters mapped to underscores, so one definition serves many hosts.

Methods read only this model's own resources for the host; every target arrives as method arguments. get/sync persist their findings in the observation resource (readable via swamp data), resolving the earlier live PARTIALs.
First release (2026.10.17.1): no earlier version or stored data to upgrade.
